name: Cenarion Wildlands
summary: In the arid waste of Desolace, the Cenarion Circle labors tirelessly to coax living green from the cracked earth. While the barren expanse remains largely hostile and desolate, druidic efforts strive to seed vital flora and awaken natural forces across the heart of the region.

sections.title: The Circle's Striving
sections.body: Desolace is infamous for its sun-bleached bones, foul centaur clans, and desolate gray soil. Yet where others see only ruin, the druids of the Cenarion Circle see wounded land crying out for renewal. Operating far from the lush forests of Kalimdor, Cenarion wardens study the lingering elemental spirits and sparse scrublands, testing rites and sowing enchanted seeds in the hope of someday reawakening life across the wasteland.

sections.title: Wild Seeds in Ash
sections.body: Restoring Desolace is far from gentle work. The land's latent elemental powers and ancient curses resist natural growth, often causing newly sprouted flora to twist into aggressive lashers or wild plant-beasts. The druids must constantly balance their nurturing rituals with martial vigilance, relying on passing adventurers to cull erratic elemental spirits and aggressive fauna that threaten their tender sprouts.

faq.q: What is the Cenarion Circle doing in Desolace?
faq.answer: The Cenarion Circle aims to heal the broken, corrupted ecology of Desolace. By channeling natural magic, studying resilient desert flora, and seeking to purify tainted soil, the druids hope to transform the bleak gray plains back into fertile wilderness.

faq.q: Why is the landscape so barren?
faq.answer: Centuries of centaur warfare, ancient demonic corruption from the Burning Blade, and severe droughts have bled the region dry of vitality. Without active natural stewardship, the soil remains dead and gray, inhabited mainly by scavenger beasts and hostile clans.

Not at all. The regeneration of Desolace is an immense and grueling undertaking. At present, the vast majority of the region remains an unforgiving wasteland, with the druids making gradual, fragile strides against hostile elemental forces and stubborn arid ground.

faq.q: Are the plants growing here dangerous?
faq.answer: Yes. When druidic energies clash with the erratic elemental currents and ancient taints of the desert, sprouting plants can mutate into aggressive lashers and thrashing thorns rather than peaceful groves. Travelers are advised to keep their guard up near sudden patches of wild growth.

angles.text: For druids of both Darnassus and Thunder Bluff, the wild experiments in Desolace represent the sacred calling of the Cenarion Circle: restoring harmony to the most scarred and abandoned corners of Kalimdor.
Though sparse, the magical reclamation of the region fosters unique and hardy flora that herbalists value greatly for potent restorative poultices and salves.
